surface: DSH Web app (existing app instance, owned disposable profile)
highlights: The portfolio band renders six figures, each a chart, each a filter.
The three overview readings (cards, board, table) hold the same project set.
The project list is visible without scrolling: it starts at 705px of a 900px viewport.
The detail page is two panes: a sticky identity rail and a scrolling reading pane.
The G0 meter shows five prerequisites including tech_owner from the identity block.
No raw template placeholders reach the DOM.
No uncaught console errors during the whole run.
notes: The harness pins prefers-color-scheme to light for the evidence shots, then flips to dark explicitly for the dark-theme assertion, so evidence describes the plugin rather than the machine it ran on.
The harness rebuilds and repacks the tarball before each run: the preview installs the packed artifact, so verifying without a rebuild would verify the previous build.
A run must start from a freshly booted Host: the console wipes its cache at mount, so the empty-state assertions only hold on the first paint.
